name: web
description: Fastify server + React client. One process, one port (decision 7).

scripts.build:server: rm -rf dist/server && esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/server/index.js --external:better-sqlite3 --external:fastify --external:@fastify/static && cp -R src/server/migrations dist/server/migrations
